618-1916-2034.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

222-527-2292-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2292-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

465-618-6495.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
465-618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

225-4094-6441-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-4094-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

5233-5412-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Repeat.

1580-4871-4976-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4522-5346-6891-7746.easyPrerequisites: A permanent you control has a removable quest counter on it.
4522-5346-6891-7746.description:
Activate Duchess by paying {1} and removing a quest counter from a permanent you control, creating a Junk token.
When the Junk enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Quest for Pure Flame triggers, putting a quest counter on it.
Activate the Junk by tapping and sacrificing it.
Crime Novelist triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Junk's ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

140-6732-7433.description:
Activate Souldrinker by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

206-3094-4659-5149-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
206-3094-4659-5149-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Power Artifact and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

240-997-3480-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4369-5231-7307.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-5231-7307.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Raphael triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Raphael triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Raphael triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7228.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two instant and/or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
6797-6972-7228.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5412-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-5702.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2173-3944-5220-5933.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2871-4146.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Murmuring Mystic trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Murmuring Mystic trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-6107.description:
Activate Exemplar of Light by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Exemplar of Light triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1491-2757-2760-6667.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Loporrit Scout, untapping a basic land.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Loporrit Scout ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.

2512-4046-6562.description:
Cast Daru Spiritualist by paying {1}{W}.
When Daru Spiritualist enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Outrider en-Kor ability.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing an opponent to lose an arbitrarily large amount of life.

1247-5963-6479.description:
Activate Marvin using Rainveil Rejuvenator's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

397-2811-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-2811-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

880-2374-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2374-4871.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1778-5220-5256-5683.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Memnite and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Memnite's power.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

413-645-914-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
413-645-914-3750.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

85-2178-3113.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
85-2178-3113.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

215-4377-5238.notablePrerequisites: Ethereal Forager does not have summoning sickness.
215-4377-5238.description:
Declare Ethereal Forager as an attacker.
Ethereal Forager triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from exile to your hand.
Activate Termur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Ethereal Forager to your hand from the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ethereal Forager by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

413-876-1475.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Lightning Greaves attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
413-876-1475.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with Lightning Greaves attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
When the Spirit(s) enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

232-4050-4316-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {R}.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Urabrask on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from the top of your library by paying {2}{R}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-2459-3139-5224.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-2459-3139-5224.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Rograkh and causing you to draw a card.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Rograkh.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {C}{C}.
When Rograkh dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

230-1912-4050-4666.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-1912-4050-4666.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
Planar Void triggers, exiling the card put into the graveyard.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {G}.
Repeat.

183-2634-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
183-2634-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

967-1157-1260-1806.manaNeeded: {1} plus an additional {1} available if Eternal Scourge is in hand
967-1157-1260-1806.description:
Cast Eternal Scourge either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}.
If you played Eternal Scourge from exile, Prosper's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, triggering Portcullis, exiling Eternal Scourge.
If you created a Treasure token, activate it by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

654-1257-3478-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Walking Atlas.
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
654-1257-3478-4222.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

643-3197-4304.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Maskwood Nexus, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Maskwood Nexus, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

541-544-2103-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Sanctum of Eternity by tapping it and paying {2}, returning Venser from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

148-3442-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Keen Sense attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
148-3442-4869.description:
Activate Patchwork Gnomes by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Keen Sense triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

618-1719.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Vizier of Tumbling Sands with haste.
Tap the Vizier of Tumbling Sands token to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite ETB and tapped creature tokens with haste.

224-872-3478.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.
